mapper.select: SELECT b.name, b.service, b.url, a.merchantno, a.status as sstatus, a.cvvyn, a.loginyn, a.verifyyn, IFNULL(a.verifylimit, 0) as verifylimit, a.dupchkyn, b.status as mstatus, b.type, IFNULL(c.amount, 0) as limitamount, IFNULL(a.secretkey, '') as secretkey, IFNULL(a.krmerchantid, '') as krmerchantid, IFNULL(a.retrymerchantid, '') as retrymerchantid, IFNULL(a.rmmalert, 'N') as rmmalert, IFNULL(a.loginviewyn, 'Y') as loginviewyn, IFNULL(a.secureyn, 'N') as secureyn FROM EXIMBAY.merchant_service a INNER JOIN EXIMBAY.ms_merchant b ON a.merchantno = b.merchantno LEFT OUTER JOIN EXIMBAY.limit_transact c ON a.merchantno = c.merchantno AND c.servicecode = 'S001' AND c.currency = #{currency} WHERE a.merchantid = #{merchantId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO EXIMBAY.transact_web ( merchantid, ref, cur, amt, email, buyer, tel, accessip, country, accesscountry, reqdt, lang ) VALUES ( #{merchantId}, #{ref}, #{currency}, #{amount}, #{email}, #{buyer}, #{tel}, #{accessIp}, #{country}, #{accessCountry}, NOW(), 'EN' )

mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(a.payto, '') as payto1, IFNULL(b.payto, '') as payto2, a.apprvcurrency, IFNULL(d.mcpyn, 'N') as mcpyn, IFNULL(a.minamount, 0) as minamount FROM EXIMBAY.service_currency a INNER JOIN EXIMBAY.van b ON a.vanno = b.vanno INNER JOIN EXIMBAY.merchant_service d ON a.merchantid = d.merchantid WHERE a.merchantid = #{merchantId} AND a.cardcode = #{cardCode} AND a.reqcurrency = #{currency}

SELECT b.vanno, b.vancode, b.urlip, IFNULL(b.port, '0') as port, b.transtype, IFNULL(e.vanshopid, '') as vanshopid, f.accttype, f.startday, f.period, f.extradays, IFNULL(e.secureyn, '') as secureyn FROM EXIMBAY.service_currency a INNER JOIN EXIMBAY.service_sys f ON a.merchantid = f.merchantid AND a.cardcode = f.cardcode INNER JOIN EXIMBAY.van b ON a.vanno = b.vanno INNER JOIN EXIMBAY.merchant_service c ON a.merchantid = c.merchantid INNER JOIN EXIMBAY.ms_merchant d ON c.merchantno = d.merchantno LEFT OUTER JOIN EXIMBAY.van_sys e ON a.vanno = e.vanno AND e.cardcode = #{cardCode} AND e.currency = #{currency} WHERE a.status = 'A000' AND b.status = 'A000' AND f.status = 'A000' AND c.status = 'A000' AND a.merchantid = #{merchantId} AND c.merchantno = #{merchantNo} AND c.servicecode = #{serviceCode} AND a.cardcode = #{cardCode} AND a.reqcurrency = #{currency}
